src/posting/ui/LifespanEditor.jsx.note: LifespanRuleEditor over LifespanModel and SelfDestruct: the switch with its line (showToggle), Delete it after or Act on it after (the five shown lengths, Other… with Length and Unit and its hint, and Or a set time on the system's date and time picker within pinBounds, with Clear), What happens then (the effects, Limit replies closed to a reply), Who can still reply (Nobody, the three groups, the writer's curation lists read through PublicAppView, and the most Bluesky takes), Conditions (optional) with Unless or Only if it reaches, a row per condition (what it counts, how it compares, how many, Remove) and Add a condition, Count quotes from, When there’s more than one, If it does or doesn’t (keep, or another window with At most), the rule in a sentence (editorNotes' summary, This post gets no timer. or No timer.) and its notes. The time is read again every thirty seconds. A row added or removed leaves the focus where the system puts it.

src/posting/ui/NeedsBackend.jsx.note: BackendAccess's four cases: nothing when ready or for no account; The long session has ended with Sign back in; Needs a long session with Reconnect for a longer session (AccountActions.lengthen), or with the line that this copy offers none. Its server glyph goes on a phone, as the web's does.

src/posting/ui/PostPreview.jsx.note: PostPreviewCard over VirgaPosting's postPreviewModel: who wrote it (the picture, the name, the handle), when (relative, the date on the pointer's tip), its words or No text, what's attached, the counts (replies, reposts, quotes, likes) and the way to it on Bluesky, and the compact form; a hairline round it. The composer draws its compact form for what a post replies to, a quoted post and Continue a thread's rows.

src/posting/ui/PostingHeader.jsx.note: PostingHeader.model and .header: Posting in the crumbs (except on the overview) or the caller's own, the page's title and line or the caller's, what it touches or not (showAccess, false where NeedsBackend stands in for the page), and the caller's actions and what goes under the header (children), drawn only when given.

src/posting/ui/QueueSettings.jsx.note: Weekly queue: the posting times a week with the week in a line and Edit the week (to Posting › Weekly schedule), the time zone (scheduleParts' TimezoneSelect: this device's first, then every zone the device knows) with the device's zone named when it differs, and Suggest posting times, over VirgaPosting's ScheduleModel (weeklyCount, weekSummary, zoneLabel, moveToZone). TimeZone.knownTimeZoneIdentifiers stands in for Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone').

src/posting/ui/SettingsParts.jsx.note: SettingsCard and SettingsRow are Settings' own SettingsSectionView and SettingsRow (a block row's control on a line of its own; a short control kept on the label's line on a phone).

src/posting/ui/StyleDialog.jsx.note: A full-height sheet with one StyleSession per opening over the account's requester: NeedsBackend without AI, the intro, how many posts to read and Read my posts, the three stages with the posts gathered, the failure (a warning for the monthly limit), How you write (editable) with its line and · not kept yet, What should change?, Refine with my note, Read my posts again with the count, the usage line, and Forget my style, Close or Cancel, Keep this (styleProfileFrom, forgetStyleProfile), a refused save's message.

src/posting/ui/TimerDialog.jsx.note: PostTimerDialog (named apart from the composer's own timer dialog, LifespanDialog), presented by .postTimerDialog($post, did:onArmed:) with a PostTimerTarget (also made from a timer note's TimerNoteArm): the owner from the post's URI, Change this post's timer or Put this post on a timer, the post's words or A post with no words of its own, NeedsBackend with Close without a long session, the bones while the limits, the timers and (when not given) the post's reply and createdAt are read, the timer it already has (its rule taking the editor's place), Start counting From now or From when it went up (relative), the rule's editor (LifespanRuleEditor with the fit, limits and holds, no toggle, counting from timerStart), when it first acts (firstActAt, the elapsed and floor leads), Set the timer or Replace the timer through createTimer (Setting…, Checking… while a lost answer is confirmed), and every refusal's words.

src/posting/ui/WhenPicker.jsx.note: The date and the time on the queue's clock (the system's pickers in its zone, the date held to min and max), the clock every 30 seconds, the quick picks (chips, one sideways row at 760 and under), the zone line with Goes out <when>, whenProblem's sentence, Repeat (its options, off with repeatBlock), Ends (Never, On a date with its default last day, After a number of times with its default count), Last day, Times in all, the note (repeatBlock, repeatProblem or repeatSummary with the occurrence's sentence), and with queue the next open time (listScheduled's queued rows, nextOpenSlot) with Set some, the error's aside and Use this time. Differences: the caller passes the weekly schedule and the account's server session (the web reads them from the did); the pickers always hold a time, so a date can't be typed without one; the fields share their row evenly.
